children: Pendle has announced a No-Yield PT/YT Reveal, a forthcoming disclosure of a technical innovation that will allow assets with no yields to be split into PT and YT in a degen-friendly manner. The team plans to share the details in the coming weeks. The update extends Pendle's core product to a much wider set of tokens that previously could not support PT/YT markets because they generate no yield.

If confirmed, the mechanism would broaden Pendle's addressable market and open potential fee and demand flows for PENDLE, since PT/YT markets have so far been limited to yield-bearing assets. The teaser gives no technical specifics or scale, so confirmation of mechanics and supported assets remains pending until the full reveal.

title: Pendle: No-Yield PT/YT Reveal to Arrive in Coming Weeks - By 04 Oct 2026
